== Course of events ==

At a school overseen by a Professor and attended by a group of pupils, two girls looked out of a window and fell from it in fright. As the Professor and the pupils rushed to check on the two girls, the Woggle-Bug escaped, emerging from the incident permanently enlarged.

This escape followed the Woggle-Bug's recounting of his own history to his companions — how he had begun life as an ordinary, tiny Woggle-Bug living among stones and grass roots — and his declared intention to travel to the Emerald City to lecture on the "Advantages of Magnification," an invitation his companions had extended for him to join their journey.

Afterward, the travelers continued toward the Emerald City. Old Mombi conjured a series of illusions — a rushing river, a granite wall, forty whirling roads, and a wall of flame — through which the Queen led the party safely, while twelve field mice concealed themselves in the straw of the Scarecrow's jacket, and the Queen of the Field Mice agreed to guide the travelers onward to the Emerald City.
